claim.claim-text: 1. A composition comprising: dehydrogenated graphite comprising a plurality of flakes having

at least one flake in 10 having a size in excess of 10 square micrometers, an average thickness of 10 atomic layers or less, and a defect density characteristic of at least 50% of µ-Raman spectra of the de-hydrogenated graphite collected at 532 nm excitation with a resolution better than 1.8 reciprocal centimeters having a D/G area ratio below 0.5, wherein the composition is a composite and at least 30%, for example, at least 50% or at least 70% of sp3 hybridized carbon sites of the composition are one or more of:
a) functionalized with a non-hydrogen chemical group, or b) cross-linked with sp3 hybridized carbon sites of another flakes.

2. The composition of claim 1, further comprising a coefficient of determination value of 2D single peak fitting of µ-Raman spectra of the de-hydrogenated graphite collected at 532 nm excitation with a resolution better than 1.8 reciprocal centimeters larger than 0.99 for more than 50 % of the spectra.
3. The composition of either claim 1 or 2, wherein

a) more than 60%, for example, more than 80%, or more than 85 % of µ-Raman spectra of the de-hydrogenated graphite have the coefficient of determination value larger than 0.99; or b) more than 40%, for example, more than 50% or more than 65 % of the µ-Raman spectra of the de-hydrogenated graphite have the coefficient of determination value larger than 0.995.
4. The composition of any one of claims 1 to 3, wherein at least one flake in six has a size in excess of 10 square micrometers, for example, at least one flake in four.
5. The composition of any one of claims 1 to 4, wherein at least one flake in ten has a size in excess of 25 square micrometers, for example, at least two flakes in ten.
6. The composition of any one of claims 1 to 5, wherein the average thickness is seven atomic layers or less, for example, five atomic layers or less.
7. The composition of any one of claims 1 to 6, wherein the defect density is:

8. The composition of any one of claims 1 to 7, wherein the composition is a particulate powder of dehydrogenated graphite flakes, for example, a black particulate powder of dehydrogenated graphite flakes.

9. The composition of any one of claims 1 to 8, wherein the plurality of the flakes of the dehydrogenated graphite are wrinkled, crumpled, or folded, for example, wherein the plurality of the flakes are assembled into a 3-dimensional structure.

10. The composition of any one of claims 1 to 9, wherein the full width half maximum of the G peak in µ-Raman spectra of the de-hydrogenated graphite collected at 532 nm excitation with a resolution better than 1.8 reciprocal centimeters is larger than 20 reciprocal centimeters, for example, larger than 25 reciprocal centimeters or larger than 30 reciprocal centimeters.

11. The composition of any one of claims 1 to 10, wherein the µ-Raman spectra of the de-hydrogenated graphite collected at 532 nm excitation with a resolution better than 1.8 reciprocal centimeters show a broad peak in the range between 1000 and 1800 reciprocal centimeters with a full width half maximum of more than 200 reciprocal centimeters, for example more than 400 reciprocal centimeters.
12. The composition of any one of claims 1 to 11, wherein more than 1%, for example, more than 5% or more than 10% of the flakes are of a thickness of more than 10 atomic layers.

13. The composition of any one of claims 1 to 12, wherein the composition is a composite, for example, wherein the composite further includes activated carbon or wherein the composite further includes a polymer.
14. An electrode comprising the composition of any one of claims 1 to 13.

15. A battery or an electrochemical capacitor comprising the electrode of claim 14, for example, wherein the battery is a lithium battery, a lithium-ion battery, a silicon anode battery, or a lithium sulfur battery.
